# Project Agent Guidance

- Keep the listing experience desktop-first and visually calm: white surfaces, warm black text, thin borders, and restrained red accents.
- Prefer small composable React components and local data fixtures over speculative backend abstractions.
- Preserve keyboard access for every modal, gallery control, and meaningful button. Escape closes overlays; arrow keys move lightbox photos.
- Run `npm run build` after UI changes.
- Keep media alt text descriptive and never use an image as the only label for an action.
